meta.title: The 10 parsec sample in the Gaia era
meta.selection: 99 entries of type *, LM, LM?, WD or WD? ordered by 1000/parallax, plus the Sun. Brown dwarfs and planets excluded. Question marks retained. Component stars counted separately.
meta.frame: Equatorial ICRS positions at each catalogue epoch, rotated to mean J2000 ecliptic axes using obliquity 23.439291111 deg. No epoch propagation or orbital simulation. Distances = 1000/parallax mas. Renderer axes: (ecliptic X, ecliptic Z, -ecliptic Y).
